M/S Ravenbhel Health Care Pvt Limited & ... vs Union Territory
Th. Food Safety Officer ... on 13 March, 2024
 Serial No. 144
 Supplementary 
 High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Srinagar 
 CrlM No. 266/2024 in
 Crm (M) No. 91/2024
 CrlM No. 242/2024. 
 M/s Ravenbhel Health Care Pvt Limited & Ors
 ... Petitioner (s)
 Through: Ms Shazia Bashir, Advocate vice
 Mr. F.A. Wani, Advocate.
 Versus
 Union Territory th. Food Safety Officer Block Bandipora. 
 ...Respondent(s)
 Through:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Sekhri, Judge
 Order
13.03.2024 For the reasons stated in the application coupled with the submissions made at Bar, the same is allowed and the Writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with leave and liberty as prayed for. 
Interim direction, if any, shall stand vacated. 
(Rajesh Sekhri) Judge SRINAGAR 13.03.2024.
